title: Lattice Moduli and Residual Atoms
summary: We study prescribed holomorphic lattices for regular-singular connections and residual factors of quantum $F$-bundles. For an arbitrary ordered monodromy spectrum, we classify the fully framed local groupoid: each residue fibre is a discrete affine space of dimension $r(r-1)$, with a unique normal form and trivial stabilisers. We then analyse elementary changes of lattice.
